lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete circular clusters of high-luminance pixels are organized into four distinct vertical columns posterior to the gills, with approximately three to four primary centroids per column before transitioning to a denser, randomized pattern towards the posterior edge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the geometric centers of the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like series of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is visible in the superior third of the visible flank, defined by a high-intensity luminance peak on the dorsal edge transitioning abruptly to a low-intensity shadow region below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, vertical, light-colored linear mark is visible in the epidermal region between the posterior-most gill slit and the leading column of primary lateral blobs.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated, yellow-hued pixel clusters attached to the ventral-lateral region near the gill slits.
